project_title: Epoxy-Acid Vitrimer Properties and Recycling Dataset
scientific_task: Collect experimentally reported synthesis parameters, thermomechanical properties, and relaxation metrics of catalyzed epoxy-acid vitrimers to model network dynamics and recycling efficiency.

record_definition.one_record: One experimentally reported vitrimer sample point with defined chemical composition (SMILES), catalyst loading, recycling cycle count, and measured thermomechanical response from a specific source.
